entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call is important to us. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hello, Sarah. I... I'm calling about an order. I'm just so disappointed, I saved up for this and I feel terrible.
I'm very sorry to hear that. I'd be happy to look into it for you. Can you tell me a bit more about what happened? What specifically is the issue with your order?
It's the jersey I bought a while back. I finally tried it on for a big ride and it's just the wrong size. It's so much smaller than I expected.
Okay, I see. So it sounds like a fit issue rather than a defect with the item, is that correct?

Yes, exactly. It's just way too tight, I can barely zip it up. I was hoping I could do an exchange or something. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years, and I really needed this money back if I can't even wear it. The holidays are coming up...
I completely understand your frustration. Let's see what we can do. Can I get your name and order number to pull up the details?
Of course. It's for Mark Peterson, order number VF78910.
Thank you, Mark. One moment... Okay, I see the order here for the Pro-Line jersey, purchased 84 days ago. Let me just confirm our policy on that for you.
Oh, it's been that long? I was so worried I was too late. I just feel awful about this.
No reason to worry at all. For our standard apparel like this jersey, we have a 90-day return window. So you are well within the timeframe for a return.
Really? Oh, thank goodness. That is such a relief to hear.
Absolutely. I can process this for you right now. I've just sent a pre-paid return label to the email on file. You can send the jersey back for a full refund.
Wow, that's amazing. Thank you so much, Sarah. You've really helped me out today. I was so stressed.
It's my pleasure, Mark. Happy to help. Is there anything else I can do for you?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
